newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro Petroleum Q3 oper shr $0.41 vs $0.27.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro Petroleum Q3 oper shr $0.41 vs $0.27.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) NOTE: Q3 pre-tax earnings benefited by $7.9 million, or $0.21 per share after-tax, received in conjunction with an outstanding receivable from Tennessee Gas Pipeline which resulted from an underpayment for natural gas purchased in prior periods. Partially offsetting this benefit was a pre-tax $3.2 million ($.09 per share after-tax) non-cash extraordinary loss in the quarter from the early extinguishment of debt, reflecting a write-off of unamortized discount and issue costs.

1995 Q3 earnings included an after-tax gain of about $33 million ($1.34 per share after-tax) from the sale of certain interests in the Bob West Field, $1.3 million ($.05 per share after-tax) of operating profit from natural gas production from the sold properties, and an about $5 million ($.19 per share after-tax) charge for restructuring costs.
